Cost: 2 Investiture

CascadeFailDet00.description: Destruction/Ruin. 07-24s: H12. Was a case in the Destruction preUseItem takeover — the FIRST step of converting it was deleting its name from EDHA_DESTRUCTION_TALENTS, because that set ends in a bare `return false` and the use event would never have fired. Cost now flows through the normal activation. The multi-catch bonus IS this talent.

CombustionChain0.description: Destruction (Razkael). Auto-fires (Reaction) when a character drops to 0 HP in your dangerous terrain: a 10 ft zone ignites on the body and each of your zones spreads 5 ft (GM grows the Regions). Using the talent posts the armed reminder + by-hand button. 2bY (iron rule 2b) - was the name-keyed defeat sweep.

The line becomes dangerous terrain for the scene, and structures and Constructs along the line take triple damage.

FaultLineZone000.description: Destruction (Razkael). A click-direction 60 ft x 5 ft line off this document's damage; each caught character tests Speed vs. your Red (engine-rolled) - failures are knocked Prone; Constructs take x3 (structures GM-side); the line becomes dangerous terrain. Cancelled pick refunds the cost. 2bY (iron rule 2b) - was the preUse takeover.

When you place a Charge on a character or an object, spend an additional 1 Investiture to declare it a Pinpoint Charge. PinpointAnnotate.description: Destruction (Razkael). description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

The first thing he learned was patience. The second was where to put the powder.

Spend 1 Investiture and place a Charge on an object, character, or 5 ft square in Attunement Range. Declare its trigger when you place it (default: start of your next turn; alternatives include "when target moves," "when target takes damage," or "when a character enters this square"). You may detonate any of your Charges as a Free Action on your turn. When a Charge detonates, each character within 10 ft takes [Tier][Die] energy damage and the detonation point becomes dangerous terrain for the scene. You may sustain up to your tier Charges; unused Charges fizzle at the end of the scene.

SetChargeZone000.description: Destruction (Razkael). Click-place a Charge marker (10 ft blast) within Red Attunement Range into the charges ledger (cap = tier, oldest fizzles); the arm card binds its trigger. The system charges the cost; a cancelled or out-of-range pick refunds it. Blast damage/type ride this document. 2bY (iron rule 2b) — was the preUse takeover.

Once per scene.
